Everpure's Product Business Unit makes bets on what to build, price, and bring to market and this role is how those bets get pressure-tested against evidence. You'll sit directly with Product leaders as their analytics partner, taking questions that arrive ambiguous ("why is adoption flattening on this platform?") and returning frameworks, models, and recommendations that change what the team does next. What makes this different from a reporting role is the ownership: you define the problem, do the analysis yourself, and stay with it through implementation. Comfort using AI in your daily work is essential here. - Day-to-day working use of generative AI and LLMs in analytics work, and a critical eye for when AI output isn't reliable enough to act on

- A track record of owning complex analytical initiatives yourself, from first conversation through implementation and measurable outcome, without needing the problem handed to you pre-scoped

- Credibility with senior business leaders; you can translate their priorities into analytical work and translate results back in terms they can act on
